assessment: This work presents valuable new information on the microtubule-binding mode of the microtubule kinesin-13, MCAK, the authors use quantitative single-molecule studies to propose that MCAK preferentially binds to a GDP-Pi-tubulin portion of the microtubule end. However, the evidence provided to support this claim remains incomplete and would benefit from more rigorous methodology particularly the diffraction limited experiments do not provide sufficient spatial resolution to support the authors' conclusions. In addition, a more through discussion of the existing literature would further strengthen the manuscript.
